openIntro: When you are ready, look through what the researchers ask for and decide what to share.
title: Share your data with the researchers
loading: Gathering what the researchers ask for…
unreachable: We could not reach the study's server just now. Your data is safe on this computer; please try again in a moment.
nothingAsked: None of the data you added is something the researchers ask for, so there is nothing to share right now.
intro: This is everything the researchers ask for, from the data you added. Take your time to look through it, and leave out anything you would rather keep to yourself. Nothing is sent until you press the button at the bottom.
leaveOutLabel: Leave out everything that contains a word, a name or a site
nested: Each row here belongs to a row of {{name}}, and is left out with it.
consentText: Your donation is locked on this computer with the study's key before it is sent, so only the researchers of this study can open it. The server that stores it cannot. You can withdraw it later from this page; the researchers then can no longer open it.
agree: I have looked at what will be shared, and I want to share it with the researchers.

problem.nothing: Everything is left out, so there is nothing to share.
problem.no-key: This study cannot receive donations yet. Please let the researchers know.
problem.wrong-key: Something is not right: the study's key is not the one in the link you came in through, so we did not send anything. Please let the researchers know.
problem.changed: The researchers changed what they ask for a moment ago. Please have another look below before you share.
problem.too-big: This is more than the study can receive in one go. Leaving out some rows may help, or ask the researchers.
problem.unreachable: We could not reach the study's server just now. Nothing was sent; please try again in a moment.
problem.failed: Something went wrong, and nothing was sent. Please try again, or let the researchers know.

receiptText: Your donation has been sent. This computer remembers it, so you can withdraw it here later. This is its code:
receiptKeep: Keep the code somewhere safe. If you remove your data from this computer, the researchers can still withdraw your donation for you with it.
confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this donation? The researchers will no longer be able to open it. This cannot be undone.

withdraw.unreachable: We could not reach the study's server just now. Please try again in a moment.
withdraw.failed: We could not withdraw this donation. Please let the researchers know, with its code.
